name: Public domain
content: The cautions and research lines in the herb book are written from pages of the US National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH, Herbs at a Glance) and the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (LiverTox). Works of the US government are in the public domain in the United States. The wording in this app is its own and adds no new rights. Each herb's sources are listed on its page and in assets/herbs.json in the source repository.
